output.summary: Evergreen partly parasitic shrub native to Europe and western and southern Asia. It grows on tree stems and produces white or yellow berries with very sticky pulp. Concentrated tea may be fatal and berries can cause serious illness, although mistletoe is an ingredient in Istrian biska liquor.
output.edibilityNote: An ingredient in Istrian biska liquor; concentrated infusions can be fatal, and berries have caused serious illness.
